local db:GlobalDataStore?=nil
local busy:{[number]:boolean}={}

local function copy(value:any):any
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local result={}; for k,v in value do result[k]=copy(v) end; return result
end
function D.defaults():T.Profile
 return {schema=1,revision=0,tips=0,gems=0,stars={},best={},inventory={chef_1=true,chef_2=true},equipped="chef_1",cosmetic="",settings={language="es",colorblind=false,reduceMotion=false,subtitles=true,music=.6,sfx=.8},receipts={},operations={},tutorial=0}
end
function D.migrate(old:any):T.Profile
 local data=if type(old)=="table" then copy(old) else D.defaults()
 assert(not data.schema or data.schema<=1,"Perfil de una versión posterior")
 for k,v in D.defaults() do if data[k]==nil then data[k]=copy(v) end end
 data.schema=1; return data
end
local function acquire(id:number):boolean
 local start=os.clock()
 while busy[id] do if os.clock()-start>12 then return false end; task.wait(.05) end
 busy[id]=true; return true
end
local function update(id:number,transform:(any)->any): (boolean,any)
 if not db then return false,nil end
 for attempt=1,4 do
  local ok,result=pcall(function() return (db :: GlobalDataStore):UpdateAsync("user_"..id,transform) end)
  if ok then return result~=nil,result end
  if attempt<4 then task.wait((2^(attempt-1))*.4+math.random()*.2) end
 end
 return false,nil
end
function D.load(p:Player):boolean
 if Env.LiveData and game.GameId==0 then return false end
 if not acquire(p.UserId) then return false end
 local ok=true; local profile:T.Profile?=nil
 if Env.LiveData then
  if not db then db=DSS:GetDataStore(Env.DataStoreName) end
  local success,result=update(p.UserId,function(old:any)
   local data=D.migrate(old)
   if data.lease and data.lease.owner~=owner and data.lease.untilTime>os.time() then return nil end
   data.lease={owner=owner,untilTime=os.time()+120,generation=(if data.lease then data.lease.generation else 0)+1}
   return data
  end)
  ok=success; profile=result
 else profile=D.defaults() end
 if ok and profile then S.profiles[p.UserId]=profile; loaded[p.UserId]=true end
 busy[p.UserId]=nil; return ok
end
function D.transact(id:number,operation:string,fn:(T.Profile)->boolean):boolean
 if not loaded[id] or closing[id] or not acquire(id) then return false end
 local committed:T.Profile?=nil; local ok=false
 if not Env.LiveData then
  local data=copy(S.profiles[id]) :: T.Profile
  if data.operations[operation] or fn(data) then data.operations[operation]=true; data.revision+=1; committed=data; ok=true end
 else
  local generation=if S.profiles[id].lease then (S.profiles[id].lease :: any).generation else -1
  local success,result=update(id,function(old:any)
   if not old or not old.lease or old.lease.owner~=owner or old.lease.generation~=generation or old.lease.untilTime<os.time() then return nil end
   local data=D.migrate(old)
   if not data.operations[operation] then
    if not fn(data) then return nil end
    data.operations[operation]=true; data.revision+=1
   end
   data.lease.untilTime=os.time()+120
   if #Http:JSONEncode(data)>3000000 then return nil end
   return data
  end)
  ok=success; committed=result
 end
 if ok and committed then S.profiles[id]=committed end
 busy[id]=nil; return ok
end
function D.renew(id:number):boolean
 if not Env.LiveData then return true end
 if not loaded[id] or not acquire(id) then return false end
 local ok,result=update(id,function(old:any)
  if not old or not old.lease or old.lease.owner~=owner or old.lease.untilTime<os.time() then return nil end
  old.lease.untilTime=os.time()+120; return old
 end)
 if ok then S.profiles[id]=result end
 busy[id]=nil; return ok
end
function D.release(id:number)
 closing[id]=true
 if not acquire(id) then return end
 if Env.LiveData and loaded[id] then
  update(id,function(old:any)
   if not old or not old.lease or old.lease.owner~=owner then return nil end
   old.lease=nil; return old
  end)
 end
 loaded[id]=nil; S.profiles[id]=nil; busy[id]=nil; closing[id]=nil
end
function D.applyReceipt(profile:T.Profile,purchaseId:string,grant:any):boolean
 if profile.receipts[purchaseId] then return true end
 if grant.kind=="gems" and type(grant.amount)=="number" and grant.amount>0 then profile.gems+=grant.amount
 elseif grant.kind=="cosmetic" and type(grant.key)=="string" then
  if profile.inventory[grant.key] then profile.gems+=(grant.duplicateGems or 0) else profile.inventory[grant.key]=true end
 else return false end
 profile.receipts[purchaseId]=true
 return true
end
return D

  for _,v in target.contents do if v.state~="raw" and v.state~="cut" then return false end end

  if not held and st.key then K.take(K.create("ingredient",st.key,"raw",st.position),p) end

  if held and held.kind=="plate" and #held.contents>0 then

  if held and held.kind=="plate" and held.state=="dirty" and not there then K.put(held,st) end
 elseif st.kind=="cut" and there and there.kind=="ingredient" and there.state=="raw" and not held then
  return "Mantén E para cortar"
 elseif held and there then
  if K.combine(held,there) then return "" end
  if K.combine(there,held) then return "" end
 elseif held and not there then
  if st.kind=="extinguisher" and held.kind~="extinguisher" then return "" end
  if C.Stations[st.kind].process and held.kind~="container" then return "Usa un recipiente" end

 end
 if S.clock-lastFire>2 then
  lastFire=S.clock
  local spread:{T.Station}={}
  for _,st in S.stations do if st.fire>0 then for _,other in S.stations do if other.fire==0 and other.team==st.team and (st.position-other.position).Magnitude<9 then table.insert(spread,other) end end end end
  for _,st in spread do st.fire=1 end

   K.put(K.create("plate","plate","dirty",st.position),st); table.remove(S.returns,i); break
  end end end

  if it.location=="flight" and it.velocity then
   local prev=it.position; it.velocity+=Vector3.new(0,-35*dt,0); it.position+=it.velocity*dt; it.elapsed+=dt

    local delta=it.position-st.position
    if math.abs(delta.X)<2.8 and math.abs(delta.Z)<2.8 and it.position.Y<=4.8 and prev.Y>=3.4 and st.fire==0 then
     local target=if st.item then S.items[st.item] else nil
     if target and target.kind=="container" then landed=K.combine(it,target)
     elseif not target and (st.kind=="counter" or st.kind=="cut") then K.put(it,st); landed=true end

  end

local S=require(script.Parent.State)
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Content)
local Matcher=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Utils.RecipeMatcher)
local Config=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local T=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types.Domain)
local O={}
local rng=Random.new(731)
function O.add(team:number)
 local pool=C.Levels[S.level].recipes
 local recipe=pool[rng:NextInteger(1,#pool)]
 local duration=Config.OrderTime*(if S.assist then 1.5 else 1)
 S.nextOrder+=1
 table.insert(S.orders[team],{id=S.nextOrder,recipe=recipe,expires=S.clock+duration,duration=duration})
end
function O.start()
 rng=Random.new(731+S.level)
 for team=1,(if S.mode=="Versus" then 2 else 1) do
  S.orders[team]={}; for _=1,3 do O.add(team) end
 end
 -- Versus comparte recetas y plazos, no el estado mutable.
 if S.mode=="Versus" then S.orders[2]={}; for _,o in S.orders[1] do table.insert(S.orders[2],table.clone(o)) end end
end
function O.deliver(team:number,parts:{T.Component}):boolean
 for index,o in S.orders[team] do
  local recipe=C.recipe(o.recipe)
  if Matcher.matches(parts,recipe.parts) and o.expires>S.clock then
   if index~=1 then S.combo[team]=1 end
   local tip=math.floor(25*math.clamp((o.expires-S.clock)/o.duration,0,1))
   S.score[team]+=(recipe.score+tip)*S.combo[team]; S.tips[team]+=tip*S.combo[team]; S.delivered[team]+=1
   if index==1 then S.combo[team]=math.min(4,S.combo[team]+1) end
   table.remove(S.orders[team],index)
   if S.mode=="Horda" then S.health=math.min(100,S.health+8); S.wave=1+math.floor(S.delivered[team]/3) end
   return true
  end
 end
 S.score[team]=math.max(0,S.score[team]-20); S.failures[team]+=1; S.combo[team]=1
 return false
end
function O.update()
 for team,orders in S.orders do
  for i=#orders,1,-1 do if orders[i].expires<=S.clock then
   table.remove(orders,i); S.score[team]=math.max(0,S.score[team]-20); S.failures[team]+=1; S.combo[team]=1
   if S.mode=="Horda" then S.health=math.max(0,S.health-20) end
  end end
  if #orders<3 then O.add(team) end
 end
end
function O.stars(team:number):number
 local stars=0; for i,threshold in C.Levels[S.level].stars do if S.score[team]>=threshold then stars=i end end
 return stars
end
return O

--!strict
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local S=require(script.Parent.State)
local L=require(script.Parent.LevelService)
local K=require(script.Parent.KitchenService)
local O=require(script.Parent.OrderService)
local D=require(script.Parent.DataService)
local A=require(script.Parent.AntiExploitService)
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Content)
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Game={}
function Game.start(player:Player,level:number,mode:string):string
 if S.phase=="Playing" then return "La partida ya está en marcha" end
 if Players:GetPlayers()[1]~=player then return "Solo el anfitrión puede iniciar" end
 if mode=="Versus" and #Players:GetPlayers()~=4 then return "Versus necesita 4 jugadores" end
 local profile=S.profiles[player.UserId]; if not profile then return "Cargando perfil" end
 local total=0; for _,stars in profile.stars do total+=stars end
 if total<C.Levels[level].unlock then return "Consigue más estrellas para abrir esta ruta" end
 if mode=="Arcade" then level=Random.new():NextInteger(1,6) end
 S.reset(); S.level=level; S.mode=mode; S.duration=G.RoundTime; S.roundId=Http:GenerateGUID(false)
 S.assist=profile.settings.assist==true and mode~="Versus"
 L.build(level,mode=="Versus"); K.seed(); O.start()
 for i,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
  local chef=S.chefs[p.UserId]
  if chef then
   chef.team=if mode=="Versus" then (if i<=2 then 1 else 2) else 1
   local off=if mode=="Versus" then (if chef.team==1 then -37 else 37) else 0
   chef.spawn=Vector3.new(off+(i-1)%2*4,4,7); chef.grace=os.clock()+4
   if chef.alternate then chef.alternate:Destroy(); chef.alternate=nil; chef.alternateHeld=nil end
   local root=A.root(p); if root then root.CFrame=CFrame.new(chef.spawn); root.Anchored=false end
  end
 end
 S.phase="Playing"; S.startedAt=os.clock(); return ""
end
function Game.finish()
 if S.phase~="Playing" then return end
 S.phase="Results"
 for _,chef in S.chefs do chef.holding=false end
 S.result={score=table.clone(S.score),tips=table.clone(S.tips),delivered=table.clone(S.delivered),failures=table.clone(S.failures),stars={[1]=O.stars(1),[2]=O.stars(2)},level=S.level,mode=S.mode}
 local roundId=S.roundId; local levelId=C.Levels[S.level].id; local mode=S.mode; local assisted=S.assist
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
  local chef=S.chefs[p.UserId]; if not chef then continue end
  local team=chef.team; local stars=O.stars(team); local score=S.score[team]; local base=math.max(5,math.floor(score/8))
  task.spawn(function()
   D.transact(p.UserId,"round:"..roundId,function(data)
    local key=levelId..(if assisted then "_assist" else "")
    if mode=="Historia" then data.stars[key]=math.max(data.stars[key] or 0,stars); data.best[key]=math.max(data.best[key] or 0,score) end
    data.tips+=base*(if mode~="Versus" and data.inventory.pass_double_tips then 2 else 1)
    return true
   end)
  end)
 end
end
function Game.update(dt:number)
 if S.phase~="Playing" or S.paused then return end
 S.clock+=dt; L.update(dt); K.update(dt); O.update()
 if S.clock>=S.duration or S.health<=0 then Game.finish() end
end
return Game

local P={}
function P.init()
 Marketplace.ProcessReceipt=function(receipt:any)
  if type(receipt)~="table" or type(receipt.PlayerId)~="number" or type(receipt.ProductId)~="number" or type(receipt.PurchaseId)~="string" or #receipt.PurchaseId>200 then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
  local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
  local grant=Env.Products[receipt.ProductId]
  if not player or not grant or not Env.LiveData or not S.profiles[receipt.PlayerId] then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end
  local ok=D.transact(receipt.PlayerId,"receipt:"..receipt.PurchaseId,function(profile) return D.applyReceipt(profile,receipt.PurchaseId,grant) end)
  return if ok then Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted else Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
 end
 Marketplace.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player,passId,purchased)
  if purchased then for key,id in Env.Passes do if id==passId then P.refresh(player,key,id) end end end
 end)
end
function P.refresh(player:Player,key:string,id:number)
 if id<=0 then return end
 local ok,owned=pcall(function() return Marketplace:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId,id) end)
 if ok and owned then
  D.transact(player.UserId,"pass:"..id,function(profile)
   profile.inventory["pass_"..key]=true
   if key=="vip_emotes" then for i=5,10 do profile.inventory["emote_"..i]=true end end
   return true
  end)
 end
end
function P.buy(player:Player,key:string,request:string):string
 local profile=S.profiles[player.UserId]; if not profile then return "Perfil no disponible" end
 if Env.Passes[key] then
  local id=Env.Passes[key]
  if id<=0 then return "Este pase todavía no está disponible" end
  Marketplace:PromptGamePassPurchase(player,id); return ""
 end
 for id,product in Env.Products do if product.offer==key then Marketplace:PromptProductPurchase(player,id); return "" end end
 local price:number?=nil
 local chef=tonumber(string.match(key,"^chef_(%d+)$"))
 if chef and chef>=1 and chef<=12 then price=(chef-1)*80 end
 for _,cosmetic in C.Cosmetics do if cosmetic.id==key then price=cosmetic.price end end
 local utensil=tonumber(string.match(key,"^utensil_(%d+)$"))
 if utensil and utensil>=1 and utensil<=4 then price=120*utensil end
 if not price then return "Oferta no disponible" end
 if profile.inventory[key] then return "Ya está en tu inventario" end
 local cost=price
 local ok=D.transact(player.UserId,"shop:"..request,function(data)
  if data.inventory[key] then return true end
  if data.tips<cost then return false end
  data.tips-=cost; data.inventory[key]=true; return true
 end)
 return if ok then "¡Añadido al inventario!" else "Propinas insuficientes o guardado pendiente"
end
return P
